variants.prompt: A striking, raven-haired beauty with emerald eyes, porcelain skin, and a heart-shaped face, exudes effortless French-Canadian allure. She struts her stuff on the sun-drenched deck of a luxurious yacht, her slender, toned figure barely contained in a tiny, black and silver sequined bikini. The metallic fabric catches the light, highlighting her every curve as she poses seductively, one long, tanned leg bent behind her. A DSLR zooms in on her daring, playful expression, the shallow depth of field blurring the background and focusing attention on her captivating eyes and plump, glossy lips.
